title: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, its free AI model optimized for GeForce RTX
summary: The open-weight model prioritizes speed over maximum intelligence and accelerates local AI by up to four times.

summary: The watermark is designed to persist even after copying, pasting, or editing the content.
